definitions.explanation: When a device, system, or mechanism operates incorrectly or activates when it should not. Commonly used for electronic equipment, sensors, alarms, and software.

examples.japanese: ⟦センサー→センサー：29781_sensaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{誤作動|ごさどう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{火災報知器|かさいほうちき}→火災報知器：11510_kasaihouchiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{誤作動|ごさどう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{避難|ひなん}→避難：07908_hinan⟧⟦させられた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We were evacuated due to a false activation of the fire alarm.

examples.japanese: ⟦ソフトウェア→ソフトウェア：04719_sofutowea⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}→更新：04765_koushin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{誤作動|ごさどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{再起動|さいきどう}→再起動：09222_saikidou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If a malfunction occurs after a software update, please restart.

notes:
{誤作動|ごさどう} means a malfunction in which a device operates incorrectly — going off when it shouldn't, doing the wrong thing, or activating without proper input.

USAGE:
- A compound of {誤|ご} (erroneous) + ⟦{作動|さどう}→作動：11692_sadou⟧ (operation, activation).
- Functions as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb and as a noun.
- A technical term common in product manuals, recall notices, and engineering reports.
- Distinguished from ⟦{故障|こしょう}→故障：01405_koshou⟧: ⟦{故障|こしょう}→故障：01405_koshou⟧ implies the device is broken or has stopped working, while {誤作動|ごさどう} implies the device is still working but operating incorrectly.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {誤作動|ごさどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧: a malfunction occurs
- {誤作動|ごさどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧: a malfunction takes place
- {誤作動|ごさどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧: to prevent malfunctions
- {誤作動|ごさどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧: the cause of the malfunction
- ⟦センサー→センサー：29781_sensaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{誤作動|ごさどう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: the sensor malfunctions / activates incorrectly
- {誤作動|ごさどう}⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧: malfunction-prevention feature

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{故障|こしょう}→故障：01405_koshou⟧: a breakdown (the device has stopped working).
- ⟦{不具合|ふぐあい}→不具合：06413_fuguai⟧: a defect, a glitch (the most general term, often used for software bugs).
- {不|ふ}⟦{作動|さどう}→作動：11692_sadou⟧: a failure to operate at all (the device doesn't activate when it should).
